correctness.rationale: The published 3A1 Hessian-minor decomposition reduces at the exceptional parameter to four reduced points plus three double roots. Exact symbolic replay verifies all seven rank-drop support points, the length-two double-root equations, three corank-one local Hessian germs with nonzero reduced v^4 coefficient 8 rho, and seven nondegenerate quadratic germs. A rank-three singular point of det(Hess f) must have kernel at a singular point of f; the three node-kernel incidence systems each have a unique projective solution, exhausting the remaining singularities. The conclusion is exactly 7 A1 plus 3 A3.

value.rationale: The exceptional divisor in the Hessian discriminant is mathematically distinguished in the lead paper, so resolving what replaces the ten generic Hessian rank-drop points is a natural structural question rather than an arbitrary parameter slice. The result identifies both the special-fiber rank-drop scheme and the full analytic Hessian singularity basket, showing a concrete collision mechanism that turns three node pairs into A3 points while retaining three separate node-induced A1 points. This is useful for studying resolutions, degenerations, and the geometry of the Hessian discriminant.
